engineer-rookie.prompt:
toy-like game art, playful and colourful, like a set of painted vinyl toys in space.
chunky rounded shapes, grotesque proportions, pushed but not too far: big engines,
bulbous cockpits, small round windows, fat pipes and bolts. soft toon shading with
2 or 3 tones and a soft rim light. matte plastic: no gloss, no reflections, no
texture noise, no grime. small glowing lights. space is dark with small soft stars.
not photographic, not realistic, no depth of field.

a cute little toy robot, not a person. a big head of one simple shape (a ball, a box,
a triangle, a capsule), a screen face with 2 glowing eyes and a strong expression,
stubby arms and feet, one big prop that tells its trade. simple cartoon shapes, a
thick clean outline, flat colour with 2 tones of shading. the shell is bright cartoon
yellow for the whole crew. matte toy plastic. one flat disc behind the head on a
plain dark backdrop.

meadow palette. one rookie engineer robot portrait, 1024 x 1024. round ball head, two eager mint screen eyes and a broad grin. squat yellow body, pastel green joints, one large soft red open-ended spanner held across the chest. plain dark forest backdrop and one pastel green disc. entire robot fits, feet visible, wide safe margins. match the approved robot anchor's thick graphic outlines, but remove all shiny highlight spots. the second reference gives only toy spirit, copy no shapes. no letters or labels.
